results.question: 各州 Olist 订单量和 Chinook 发票数对比

SELECT state,
       SUM(olist_order_count) AS olist_order_count,
       SUM(chinook_invoice_count) AS chinook_invoice_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS olist_order_count,
           0 AS chinook_invoice_count
    FROM olist_orders_dataset o
    JOIN olist_customers_dataset c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

    SELECT i.BillingState AS state,
           0 AS olist_order_count,
           COUNT(*) AS chinook_invoice_count
    FROM chinook.Invoice i
    WHERE i.BillingState IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY i.BillingState
) t
GROUP BY state

results.question: Olist 月度订单量趋势分析，哪个月最高哪个月最低？
results.agent_sql:
SELECT month, order_count
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM olist_orders_dataset
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
) AS monthly
WHERE order_count = (
    SELECT MAX(order_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
        FROM olist_orders_dataset
        GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
    ) AS m
)
OR order_count = (
    SELECT MIN(order_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
        FROM olist_orders_dataset
        GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
    ) AS m
)
ORDER BY order_count DESC, month;
results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM olist_orders_dataset GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

metrics.judge_notes: SQL逻辑正确，但回答仅给出最高最低值，未提供趋势分析，且输出格式缺少解释。

results.question: Olist 哪个卖家的延迟发货率最高？列出 TOP 5
results.agent_sql:
SELECT oi.seller_id,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > date(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS delayed_shipment_rate
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi

results.question: Chinook Rock 流派为什么收入最高？分析曲目数和单价的关系
results.agent_sql:
SELECT g.Name AS genre_name,
       t.track_count,
       t.avg_unit_price,
       r.revenue
FROM chinook.Genre g
JOIN (
    SELECT GenreId,
           COUNT(*) AS track_count,
           ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM chinook.Track
    GROUP BY GenreId
) t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
JOIN (
    SELECT tr.GenreId,
           ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue
    FROM chinook.InvoiceLine il
    JOIN chinook.Track tr ON il.TrackId = tr.TrackId
    GROUP BY tr.GenreId
) r ON g.GenreId = r.GenreId
ORDER BY r.revenue DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS tracks, ROUND(AVG(il.UnitPrice), 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.Genre g JOIN chinook.Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN chinook.InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

metrics.judge_notes: track_count为全部曲目数而非实际参与销售的曲目数，与参考答案不一致；收入数据正确，但未回答‘为什么收入最高’及曲目数与单价的关系，缺乏分析解读。
